title: the tailscale CLI probe cannot run at all -> unknown, never a pass
titleZh: tailscale CLI 探针根本跑不起来 -> unknown,绝不 pass
why: The layer above the process launch: with -NoNative and no fixture entry the ip -4 probe has no available result, so the collector has nothing to judge and must say unknown/ts_probe_failed. This is the state that would come from a genuinely absent binary as well, and it is deliberately NOT the same reason key as a denied pipe or a logged-out node - each needs a different human action. This is deliberately a DIFFERENT case from fault-tailscale-not-installed: there the binary exists nowhere the collector looks (blocked, with a remedy) and here the probe produced no usable result at all (unknown, nothing to fix). A test that merged the two would let one of the reasons silently take over the other.
inject: -NoNative with the tailscale ip -4 probe removed from the fixture
